mechanism: Both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism and may compete for CYP3A4/2D6 enzymatic pathways; zidovudine metabolism may be affected by tolterodine's anticholinergic effects on GI motility and absorption.
action: Monitor for zidovudine efficacy and tolterodine adverse effects; consider dose adjustments if signs of reduced antiretroviral effect or increased anticholinergic toxicity occur.
